body.prose:
A version holds what the store needs and the holon's body: the holon's id, the version before it, what the holon is an instance of, and its body. The body is whatever the holon holds, shaped by its types: a brief's title and prose live there, as a track's title and length would. Versions are the atoms: everything else in the store only points at them.

```json
{ "kind": "version", "id": "01JB…store", "prev": "sha256-27…",
  "instance": ["01JA…brief"],
  "body": { "title": "The store", "prose": "A store is where a field is kept …" } }
```

Every object says what kind it is, so any one of them can be read alone, by a person browsing the files or a program checking them, without knowing how it was reached.

*The author's, 2026-11-02: a holon is what the storage needs and then its body, and title and prose go into the body. Keeping `kind` the session's.*

A version is to hold two more of what the storage needs, out of the body: the holon's name, and, if it is a type, its fields, what its instances hold, each with its prose and the shape the engine checks. A holon is then a type by having fields, and needs to be an instance of nothing to be one; the body holds only what the holon holds itself. Not yet built: the vectors, the store and the engine change with it.

```json
{ "kind": "version", "id": "01JB…paragraph", "name": "paragraph", "prev": "sha256-…",
  "instance": [],
  "fields": { "text": { "says": "What it says: words, and the links and terms among them.",
                        "shape": { "either": [ "string", { "list": { "either": [ "string", { "$ref": "01JB…link" }, { "$ref": "01JB…term" } ] } } ] } } },
  "body": { "title": "Paragraph", "says": "One point of prose, read in its place." } }
```

*The author's, 2026-11-05: name first class; fields goes out of the body, for whether you are a type by being an instance of Type or by having fields was double. A type by its fields, and Type let go, the session's answer, which the author has not yet ratified; glass's engine already finds a type by its fields.*
body.title: A version is one holon as it stood
